evan: Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring issues are missing spans (headers dropped), aggregation inflation from ETL replays, and occasional lag tied to checkpoint GC. Need single owners, short timelines, and a small backfill plan for the affected windows.
meera: I'll take ETL checkpoint durability + dedupe. Plan: write checkpoints to objectstore with write-once filenames and add a sequence check in the worker. ETA 3 days. Backfill plan: targeted recompute for the affected 4h window.
sam: I'll own aggregation dedupe in the reducer. Hypothesis: partial retry path emits duplicates. I'll add idempotency keys and a smoke test. ETA 4 business days.
ryan: I'll own header propagation changes in edge + SDK. Add header-enforce flag behind FF, CI test to assert header roundtrip. ETA 48 hours.
ops-bot: Postmortem doc posted: https://confluence.redwood.example/pm/202567  reminder created for owners.
evan: Please paste 1-line rollback for each and a short verification query. Also ops needs the core backfill SQL snippet for perms review.
meera: Rollback: disable new checkpoint writer and revert worker image. Verify: SELECT count(*) FROM raw_events WHERE seq_missing = true LIMIT 1;
sam: Rollback: revert reducer image. Verify: run duplicate-detect query on staging.
ryan: Rollback: flip header-enforce flag off. Verify: curl -H "X-Trace-ID: test" https://edge-test/health | grep test
meera: backfill SQL (trimmed):
SELECT metric, window_start, SUM(value) as value
FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, metric, window ORDER BY event_ts DESC) rn FROM raw_events WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-22T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-22T06:00:00Z') t WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY metric, window_start;
evan: Success criteria: missing spans <0.05% after rollout; rollup diffs <0.5% after backfill; ETL lag <90s steady-state. If any owner thinks this is unrealistic, flag now.
meera: OK. I'll post runbook + dry-run plan by EOD+2.
sam: I'll open PR with tests by EOD+3.
ryan: I'll ping @cdn-team and mobile leads now and post CI results.
evan: Great. I'll consolidate tasks into the PM doc and set due dates: ryan EOD+2, meera EOD+2 (runbook), sam EOD+3. Ops will reserve a 90 minute maintenance window for the backfill tonight 03:00-04:30 UTC. Keep updates short in-thread.
